Rules & lab checklist

Six pieces per player. Green moves first. Men step diagonally forward but may capture in any direction. Kings fly: they move any distance along a diagonal and capture from any distance, landing on any empty square beyond. Captures are compulsory; complete every available jump in a chain. A man that reaches the far side mid-capture becomes a king and keeps jumping. Captured pieces are removed when your move ends and cannot be jumped twice. No legal moves means a loss. Eighty turns without a capture or promotion means a draw.

For a web move, move the physical pieces to match the screen, including captured pieces. Bright green squares on the board show where to place a piece; amber squares show where to remove one. The next turn stays paused until they match. Magnet presence does not identify a piece’s colour or king status.

This session runs in this browser. Refreshing clears it. USB play needs this laptop attached. Wi-Fi play uses a paired board and the connection service. Remote-browser multiplayer is not implemented; this browser still owns the game.
